newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint steady versus dollar at close.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint steady versus dollar at close.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed little changed against the dollar on Thursday in quiet trade, dealers said.
The forint finished at 156.18/23, compared to an opening of 156.20/25 and stayed within five pips of the central bank bid all day.
"There was little movement anywhere today," said Attila Behan of ING Bank. "Even the foreign markets lacked impetus."

The featureless international picture was reflected on the currency futures markets of the Budapest Commodity Exchange where trade was evenly distributed between the Ecu, mark, dollar and yen, with the sterling and the Swiss franc also registering turnover.
Most currencies either eased or remained steady. Only the Swiss franc firmed for December and June.
